settings.title: Settings
settings.resetConfirm: Delete all local progress on this device? This cannot be undone.

unlock.title: New!
unlock.factor: Multiplier gates: shoot them to raise the multiplier.
unlock.tank: Tanks: tough enemies that crush several soldiers.
unlock.percent: Damage and fire-rate gates boost every soldier.
unlock.barrel: Explosive barrels: shoot them near enemies.
unlock.shooter: Shooters stop and fire at you. Take them out first.
unlock.spread: Spread gun: three pellets per shot.
unlock.barrier: Walls! Steer around them or lose soldiers.
unlock.shield: Shield bearers block straight shots. Hit them from the side or use spread and rockets.

account.title: Account
account.signedOutText: Sign in with Google to keep your progress in the cloud and continue on any device. You can always play as a guest without an account.
account.guestNote: Your current guest progress is added to your account the first time you sign in on this device.
account.unavailable: Sign-in is currently not available. Your progress is saved on this device.
account.maintenance: The game is in maintenance mode. Sign-in is temporarily disabled.
account.deleteConfirm: Delete your account and all cloud data? Your progress stays on this device. This cannot be undone.
account.signOutNote: After signing out your progress stays on this device as a guest.

loginResult.ok: Signed in. Your progress is now saved in the cloud.
